legend: You have a set $$$S$$$ containing the first $$$n$$$ powers of $$$2$$$. However, Thomas tampered with your set and negated some of its values. For example, for $$$n=4$$$, $$$S = \{1, 2, 4, 8\}$$$, and Thomas could negate the $$$2$$$ and $$$4$$$ to turn $$$S$$$ into $$$\{1, -2, -4, 8\}$$$.
You are given a positive integer $$$k$$$. Express $$$k$$$ as the sum of some subset of $$$S$$$, or state that this is impossible.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1\le t\le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1\le n \le 30$$$, $$$1 \le k  \lt  2^n$$$) — the size of $$$S$$$ and the target sum, respectively.
The next line consists of $$$n$$$ characters $$$+$$$ and $$$-$$$, where the $$$i$$$-th character is $$$-$$$ if Thomas negated $$$2^{i-1}$$$ and $$$+$$$ otherwise.
output: For each test case, if there is no subset adding up to $$$k$$$, print $$$-1$$$.

Otherwise, print a string of $$$n$$$ characters $$$\texttt{#}$$$ and $$$\texttt{.}$$$, where the $$$i$$$-th character is $$$\texttt{#}$$$ if you include the $$$i$$$-th element in the subset, and $$$\texttt{.}$$$ otherwise.
If there are multiple solutions, you can print any.
note: In the first test case, $$$S = \{1, -2, -4, 8\}$$$ and $$$k=2$$$. We can choose the subset $$$\{-2, -4, 8\}$$$, which adds up to $$$2$$$.
In the second test case, $$$S = \{-1, -2, -4\}$$$. Since all elements of $$$S$$$ are negative, we cannot choose a subset of $$$S$$$ that adds up to $$$k=5$$$.

legend: 给定一个正整数 $$$k$$$。将 $$$k$$$ 表示为 $$$S$$$ 的某个子集的和，或者说明这是不可能的。
input: 输入的第一行包含一个整数$$$t$$$ ($$$1\le t\le 10^4$$$）——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 $$$n$$$ 和 $$$k$$$ ($$$1\le n \le 30$$$、$$$1 \le k  \lt  2^n$$$）--分别是 $$$S$$$ 的大小和目标总和。
output: 对于每个测试用例，如果没有子集累加到 $$$k$$$，则打印 $$$-1$$$。
否则，打印一个由 $$$n$$$ 字符 $$$\texttt{#}$$$ 和 $$$\texttt{.}$$$ 组成的字符串，其中如果子集中包含 $$$i$$$ -th 元素，则 $$$i$$$ -th 字符为 $$$\texttt{#}$$$，否则为 $$$\texttt{.}$$$。
如果有多种解决方案，你可以打印任何一种。
note: 在第二个测试案例中，$$$S = \{-1, -2, -4\}$$$。由于$$$S$$$的所有元素都是负数，我们无法选择$$$S$$$的子集与$$$k=5$$$相加。
